text:
marta: FYI rolling BMC microcode update (mc v2.1.7) pushed to OOB controller ~00:10 UTC — seeing sporadic SOL (serial-over-lan) disconnects on ~12 racks in us-west-1. Kicked off runbook.
lee: saw it, nodes went NotReady, scheduler rescheduled pods -> capacity drop ~18% for g4/g5 pools.
sanjay: tagging @kira @eng-sre — any quick mitigation?
kira: rerouted provisioning to eu-west-1 for canaries, but large tenants hit. Temporarily bumped Dedicated burst to avoid throttles.
ops-bot: Deploy recorded: microcode-update/bmc/mc-2.1.7 -> us-west-1 (12 racks) at 2026-03-17T00:10Z 
ethan: logs show OOB watchdog reset spam: "SOL: link down, resetting session" repeating every 30s. sample: 
```
[2026-03-17T00:12:05Z] sold[1234]: link down, reset session
[2026-03-17T00:12:35Z] bmc-watchdog: kick failed: timeout
```
marta: adding quick isolation steps we used: 
```
# quick oob isolation
1) oobctl rack list | grep us-west-1
2) for r in <racks>; do oobctl rack $r firmware rollback mc-2.1.6 || oobctl rack $r set maintenance; done
3) k8s: kubectl cordon $(nodes -l rack=$r) && kubectl drain $(nodes -l rack=$r) --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```
lee: rollback worked on 3 racks so far, 9 still flapping due to PSU/BMC UART bus collisions (weird).
sanjay: consequence: spilled to on-demand cloud for ~6h to handle reschedules. Estimated incremental cost ~ $11k today — tagging finance.
kira: filed vendor ticket #78923 — vendor suspects a watchdog pacing change in mc-2.1.7 that interacts poorly with older Supermicro BMC firmwares.
marta: proposed plan: 1) halt rollout, 2) build mc-2.1.8 with legacy watchdog pacing option, 3) run small canary in us-west-2 + hardware SOL stress tests, 4) schedule coordinated rollback for remaining racks. Also suggest using reserved Dedicated burst to avoid customer impact during remediation.
ethan: FYI secure-boot flag toggles don't look root-caused, but saw one forced-reboot node report secure-boot state flip — investigating persistent state.
lee: next steps: @ops-bot create incident ticket, @marta update status page, @sanjay notify finance and affected account owners.
marta: on it, will post status update in 15m. thanks all :heart:
